note: The built stone: the stair, the blocks and the rocks. Every one of them was a bake that the masonry generator replaces, and this fragment has finished emptying out: it declares nothing, and it stays because the layer still exists and the record of what it stopped asking for belongs beside it.
retired: rocks-scene (rocks/rocks.glb) and rock-light (rocks/rock-light.png) were the
first two to go. The rocks are piles of cubes on the world's own lattice now,
generated in src/world/rock-piles.js from the plan the reference camera traced,
and drawn by the stone material the six blocks are drawn by. The layer's `plant`
phase went with them: it had nothing left to build.
AND THE SIX THAT WERE NAMED HERE AS THE SAME DEBT ONE STEP BEHIND ARE GONE
TOO, with the sources they named:
stairs-albedo     terrain/stairs-albedo.png       126 674 B
stairs-light      terrain/stairs-light.png        148 704 B
monoliths-scene   monoliths/monoliths.glb         236 552 B
monolith-albedo   monoliths/stone-albedo.png      150 697 B
monolith-relief   monoliths/stone-normal.png      129 688 B
monolith-light    monoliths/monolith-light.png  1 105 045 B
Nothing read any of them. The stair and the platform are masonry-scalinata and
masonry-piattaforma, cut on the world's lattice and drawn by the same material
as the blocks; the blocks' own albedo and relief are generated in
src/world/voxel/masonry.js and never spedited; the two light maps were a Cycles
bake this world stopped lighting itself with when src/world/face-light.js became
the one seat. v2-pietra declares `needs: []` at dress, and no source in src/
names any of the six as a string.
The pictures they were painted from stay reproducible: tools/monoliths/
paint-stone.mjs still writes stone-albedo.png and stone-normal.png, and
tools/terrain/paint-stairs.mjs still writes stairs-albedo.png. A tool that can
make a retired thing again is a record; a source sitting in assets-src that a
manifest declares is weight on the wire. The two light maps had no tool at all:
they were baked outside this repository and they are simply gone.
WHAT IS NOT DONE HERE, WITH ITS NUMBER, because a session does not commit a
delivery (tools/guards/guard-no-delivery.mjs): the manifest under public/assets
still names all six, 807 579 B of them, and src/core/assets.js fetches every
critical entry it finds there whatever any layer asks for. So until the delivery
is rebuilt those bytes are still on the wire. They are not alone in that -- the
same delivered manifest still names terrain-albedo, terrain-detail, terrain-path,
terrain-light, rocks-scene and rock-light, which no fragment has declared for
some time -- and ONE rebuild settles all of them at once. It is the integrator's,
and it is named here rather than half-done.
